title: Triangulated structure transfer across an equivalence
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], and let D be a category equivalent to C via e : C ≌ D, with arbitrary object and Hom universes. There exist a zero object, a preadditive structure, an additive integer shift, a pretriangulated structure and a triangulated structure on D, and a shift comparison for e.functor, such that e.functor is triangulated and e.inverse is triangulated for the inverse shift comparison induced by the equivalence adjunction.

source.place: Tags 05QK and 05QL: triangulated category and exact functor axioms; transport by an equivalence

proof.text: Construct the shifted, additive, triangulated structure on the equivalent category using localization at isomorphisms and the induced shift; verify the triangulated functor and its inverse by the equivalence unit and counit.

lean.statement:
theorem triangulatedEquivalenceTransfer
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C]
    (e : C ≌ D) :
    ∃ (_ : HasZeroObject D) (_ : HasShift D ℤ) (_ : Preadditive D)
      (_ : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive) (_ : Pretriangulated D)
      (_ : IsTriangulated D) (_ : e.functor.CommShift ℤ),
      let := e.commShiftInverse ℤ
      e.functor.IsTriangulated ∧ e.inverse.IsTriangulated
